steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the tenant.
Apply the setting whose effect on the draft vendor option is under test.
Apply the additional configuration required by the case.
Provide the required event title so the draft can be saved and found again.
Apply a pricing template required for a valid eRFX draft.
Add the minimum line item needed for the draft.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a schedule so the draft has the normal event configuration.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft under test.
Navigate to Events to reopen the saved draft through the buyer flow.
Show saved drafts as required by the scenario.
Confirm the newly saved draft is present in the Drafts tab.
Open the specific draft created by this plan.
Assert that the “12” option is not offered in the saved draft.
